titleTr: İşte bir olay: when ve while

explainTr: Bir olay anlatırken uzun süren eylem Past Continuous, onu kesen kısa olay Past Simple olur: I was cooking when the phone rang. 'Ben yemek yapıyordum' arka plan, 'telefon çaldı' ani olaydır.
while + süren eylem (Past Continuous): While I was cooking, the phone rang. when + kısa olay (Past Simple): When the phone rang, I was cooking.
İki eylem aynı anda sürüyorsa ikisi de Past Continuous olabilir: While she was reading, he was cooking. Kısa olaylar peş peşe olduysa ikisi de Past Simple olur: When the bell rang, we left.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'ben yemek yaparken telefon çaldı' demek yeter, zaman ekleri kendiliğinden uyar. İngilizcede uzun eylem (was cooking) ile kısa olayı (rang) ayrı zamanlarla göstermen gerekir.

reading.title: The alarm in the cafeteria
reading.text:
On Tuesday, Hafsa was helping in the school cafeteria as a lunch volunteer. While the children were eating, two boys started to argue about a seat. Hafsa was walking toward them when a girl spilled her juice on the floor. She was getting a towel when the fire alarm suddenly rang.

The cafeteria became very loud. Some children were laughing, and some were crying. Hafsa remembered her training. While the lunch teacher was calling the principal on the radio, Hafsa raised her hand and said calmly, "Everybody, stop talking. Line up at the door." The children listened. They gathered in a line, and she counted them.

When they reached the playground, the alarm was still ringing. Teachers from every classroom were standing on the grass with their students. The principal, Ms. Torres, was talking to a firefighter when Hafsa arrived. A few minutes later, the firefighter laughed. "It's a false alarm," he said. "Someone was burning popcorn in the teachers' lounge."

While the children were walking back inside, Ms. Torres thanked Hafsa. "You were calm while everyone else was running around," she said.

Hafsa smiled. "I was nervous," she answered, "but I remembered what I learned."

writing.promptTr: İşte ya da okulda olan bir olayı anlatan kısa bir hikâye yaz (80-120 kelime). when ve while kullan; süren eylem için Past Continuous, ani olay için Past Simple.
writing.promptEn: Write a short story about an event at work or school. Use when and while with the past continuous and past simple.
writing.model:
Last Wednesday, I was helping in the school library when the lights went out. The children were reading quietly, and a few of them were working on computers. Suddenly everything became dark, and a little girl started to cry.

While the librarian was looking for a flashlight, I sat with the girl and told her a short story. The other children listened carefully. When the lights came back, everybody clapped.

Later, the principal said the problem was a broken wire outside. I was happy because the children stayed calm. It was a small event, but I learned that a quiet voice can help a lot.
